en: Saxon Switzerland imposes a ban on entry - a fine of up to 10,000 euros for violations. After the severe storm in Saxon Switzerland, the district office banned entry to affected forest areas until August 3rd. Fallen trees and drooping crowns pose an acute danger. Violations can be costly.
la: Saxones Helvetia bannum in visco - mulcta usque ad 10,000 nummorum violationes imponit. Post gravem in Saxonia Helvetiorum tempestatem, regio officio interdictum est introitus ad areas silvarum affectas usque ad diem 3 Augusti. Arbores lapsae et caducae coronae acutum periculum ponunt. Violationes pretiosae esse possunt.
